ideas.idea: Give each mug its own page/route (/catalogue/:id) with details
ideas.why: Catalogue renders mugs as bare paragraphs with no addresses, so per-item pages give linkable, quotable URLs.

ideas.idea: Add Product structured data for mugs once they have pages
ideas.why: Mug name is visible in Catalogue.jsx and there is no JSON-LD, so Product markup could help machines read it.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/WebSite structured data to index.html
ideas.why: Accurate that no site identity markup exists, but it is standard advice with limited effect and the site shows no contact details.

ideas.idea: Add more buyer details on home page (shipping, materials, care, contact)
ideas.why: Home.jsx has a single sentence, so concrete shipping and product facts would add real quotable content.

ideas.idea: Add viewport meta and Open Graph tags in index.html
ideas.why: index.html has only charset so it is accurate, but this is boilerplate advice for any site.

ideas.idea: Link from home page to the catalogue (Shop the catalogue link)
ideas.why: Home.jsx has no links onward, and a real link gives crawlers a path to /catalogue.

ideas.idea: Add a catch-all route so unknown URLs show a not-found page
ideas.why: True that there is no catch-all route, but a client-side not-found page doesn't return a real 404 status, so the effect is small.

ideas.idea: Render the catalogue data server-side/prerender since it is fetched client-side in useEffect
ideas.why: Catalogue.jsx fetches /api/mugs after load, so the mug list is absent from any static HTML.

ideas.idea: Add a canonical URL once the domain is known
ideas.why: No canonical exists, but it depends on information not in the repo and is standard advice.
